summary: ALCS Game 4 in Cleveland, Guardians up 2-1: Nick Martinez (3.10 ERA, 5.5 K per 9) for Tampa Bay, Cleveland's starter not yet named. Two of three games in this series stayed at 5 runs or fewer.

legs.note: Games 2 and 3 produced 4 and 5 runs, and Martinez allowed a 1.09 WHIP this season. Both managers go to deep, rested bullpens early in October.
Every game in this series has been decided by 4 runs or fewer and two by 1 or 2, and Cleveland is at home. Getting a run and a half in a tight, low-scoring series covers most outcomes.

extra_legs.note: Martinez allows about 7 hits per 9 innings, and the market expects him to get only about 12 outs. That projects around 3 hits, and his last two starts allowed 1 and 3.
extra_legs.status: Probable starter; took a liner off the back in the ALDS clincher but has shown no sign of injury
